Author: Gergely_Blasko
Text: @NYChichas $VKTX I’m a VK (and $NVO) holder and bull, and VK2735 looks extremely promising. But bullish doesn’t mean we should misrepresent data. This chart is misleading, especially on tolerability. Retatrutide AE numbers include titration, when GI side effects are highest. The much better-looking VK2735 figures (49% TEAE, 5% nausea, 2% discontinuation) come from post-induction maintenance in patients already treated/titrated for 21 weeks. Not apples-to-apples. VK2735 efficacy is genuinely impressive: -17.7% W21 and -21.7% W33 with no apparent plateau. But W33 continuous dosing was only n=13. Different trials, populations, titration schedules and observation periods. VK2735 may ultimately prove equally effective or better tolerated than retatrutide. I hope it does. But let the data prove it. This chart doesn’t. $LLY $NVO $VKTX

Text: Nektar Therapeutics said a U.S. jury awarded the company $90 million in damages in its contractual dispute with Eli Lilly over a former collaboration to develop and commercialize rezpegaldesleukin. The $90 million award is subject to additional interest to be determined by the court.
